responses.text:
Please index Zotero AI Notes v0.5.0 for Zotero 9 and 10, superseding the earlier v0.4.2/v0.4.3 request.

This pre-release adds a PDF-bound reader Q&A sidebar, separate local conversations, follow-up questions, source-page citations, and user-selected Q&A collection into Zotero notes. Collected answers are labeled AI-assisted explanations.

Release: https://github.com/STRUGGLE1999/zotero-ai-notes/releases/tag/v0.5.0
Asset: https://github.com/STRUGGLE1999/zotero-ai-notes/releases/download/v0.5.0/zotero-ai-notes-0.5.0.xpi
Compatibility: Zotero 9.0–10.0.*
SHA-256: 51f1932839d117d2757e6874d30102c056ce4deb704ff6f162d3ef10b618cf6d

Validation: npm run check and GitHub CI passed (87 tests); macOS Zotero 10.0.6 verified PDF switching, follow-ups with citations, draft preservation and saving selected Q&A. Windows/Linux hands-on regression remains pending. Keyword retrieval uses up to six page excerpts; scanned PDFs and semantic retrieval are not supported yet.

Manifest: https://github.com/STRUGGLE1999/zotero-ai-notes/blob/main/addon/manifest.json
Automatic updates: https://github.com/STRUGGLE1999/zotero-ai-notes/blob/main/updates.json
responses.reply:
The card follows the repository's latest full release, still 0.3.5 (Zotero 9 only). Every release from 0.3.7 to 0.5.0 is marked as a pre-release, so the card says it doesn't work with Zotero 10.

Your updates.json already serves 0.5.0 to every installed copy, and we've analysed that file (the same SHA-256 as above): every check of its code came out low. The quickest way onto the card is to publish it as a full release; our daily census picks it up by itself.

We're also deciding how cards should handle a plugin whose own update address serves a newer version than its latest full release, for every plugin at once.
